facts.fact: The Ministry of Education opened a five-day session in Kakata to develop and validate a Statutory School Record-Keeping Booklet as the common nationwide system for school-level records on students, teachers and attendance; the document names no digital system at schools and does not use the word paper (document date used, no event date given).

systems.tiers: county education teams use the fact sheets for County Education Operational Plans

note: The one fact is the school-level record itself being a booklet; the parent should check its class and value, since the document says booklet, not paper, and does not say paper only.
